_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: The trailing slashes are load-bearing; Sentry redirects without them and a POST that follows a redirect loses its body.
Read scopes only. Write access on an error tracker would let a task resolve or delete issues, which destroys the record it was reading.
Access tokens last 30 days rather than an hour, so refresh is less frequent but still required.
Self-hosted Sentry uses the same paths on the installation's own host.

personal_token.label: Internal integration token
personal_token.where: sentry.io > Settings > Developer Settings > Internal Integrations - create one with read permissions.
notes: Simpler than OAuth for a single organisation and scoped the same way.

rate_limits.note: Per organisation, returned as 429 with X-Sentry-Rate-Limit headers. Issue listing is paginated by cursor, not offset.
